title: Add beads issue detection to project artifacts
description: Detect whether a project directory contains a .beads/ directory. If so, run 'bd list --json' to fetch open issues and include them in ProjectArtifacts. Add a BeadIssue type to types.ts and a beadsIssues field to ProjectArtifacts.

title: Add REST endpoint for beads issues
description: Add GET /api/projects/:id/issues endpoint that runs 'bd list --json' in the project directory and returns the results. Consider caching since bd list requires spawning a process.

title: Support GitLab issues and merge requests
description: Add GitLab integration alongside GitHub. Fetch issues and MRs via glab CLI or GitLab API for projects with a GitLab remote. Show in the same kanban board and PR views as GitHub, with appropriate source badges.

title: Support GitHub Issues in project issues view
description: The issues board currently only supports beads (bd) issues. Extend it to also display GitHub Issues for projects that have a linked GitHub repo (via ~/.claude.json githubRepoPaths). Fetch open/closed GitHub issues via gh issue list --json, normalize into a unified ProjectIssue type, show alongside beads issues in the kanban board with a source badge/icon, and link back to the GitHub issue URL in the drawer.

title: Use URL params for plans tab state management
description: Plans tab should use route params and URL search params for state, similar to how the issues tab uses ?issue=<id> for the drawer. Allow deep-linking to a specific plan so URLs are shareable and browser back/forward works.

title: Investigate generic issue/task tracker integration layer
description: Research how to support multiple external issue trackers (GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Linear, etc.) without N separate implementations. Consider: a common ProjectIssue/ProjectPR interface that each provider maps to, auto-detection from git remotes or config, plugin/adapter pattern for adding new providers. Deliverable is a design doc or plan, not implementation.

title: Show open/closed PRs for a project
description: Add a Pull Requests view for repos with a GitHub link. Fetch PRs via gh pr list --json (open + recently merged/closed). Display as a new sub-nav tab or section on the project overview. Show PR status (open/merged/closed), title, author, review state, CI status. Link each PR to its GitHub URL. Only show for projects with a GitHub repo link in ~/.claude.json.

title: Add issue count to project sub-nav
description: Show the count of open beads issues in the project sub-nav tabs, similar to how Plans and Sessions show counts. Add an Issues tab between Plans and Sessions.

title: Investigate session discovery for Claude Code IDE plugins (VS Code, Cursor, Zed)
description: Research how Claude Code's IDE plugins (VS Code, Cursor, Zed) store their session data — JSONL paths, project directory encoding, process names, etc. Currently the relay discovers CLI sessions via ps + lsof and reads JSONL from ~/.claude/projects/. IDE plugins may use different paths, process names, or session formats. Investigate: where do IDE plugin sessions write JSONL? Do they use the same ~/.claude/projects/ directory structure? Are the process names different (e.g. not 'claude' in ps output)? What changes are needed in discoverExisting/scanAllSessions to pick up IDE sessions? Goal: surface IDE plugin sessions in the relay UI the same way we surface terminal CLI sessions.

title: Add sorting controls to the issues kanban board
description: Add a sort dropdown/toggle to the issues page that lets users sort issue cards within columns by date submitted (newest/oldest), priority (highest/lowest), or issue type (task/feature/bug/etc). Persist the selected sort via URL search params.

title: Show beads issues in project overview UI
description: Add an Issues section to the project overview page that displays beads issues when available. Show issue ID, title, status, priority, type, and assignee. Group by status (open/in_progress first). Use existing UI component patterns (cards, badges).

title: Improve plans tab UX with search and filtering
description: The plans tab currently shows a flat list of plan cards. As projects accumulate plans, it becomes hard to find specific ones. Add search (filter by title/content as you type), sort (newest/oldest, alphabetical), and filtering (by status if applicable). Consider showing plan metadata (date created, related sessions) to help distinguish similar plans.
